description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. 

 Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. 
 
 Build, Innovate, and Showcase the Technology Transforming Medical Imagin g

 About the Role
 Siemens Healthineers is seeking a technically skilled and motivated Enterprise Imaging Solutions Engineer to help build, maintain, and advance the demonstration environments that showcase our Enterprise Imaging solutions.
 In this role, you will be a key technical partner to our sales, clinical, and solution engineering teams, ensuring our demonstration platforms deliver reliable, compelling experiences for healthcare customers.

 This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced PACS Administrator, Enterprise Imaging Implementation Engineer, Healthcare IT Systems Engineer, or Technical Solutions Specialist who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to expand their expertise in enterprise imaging, cloud technologies, advanced visualization, AI, and healthcare interoperability.

 You will work with a broad range of technologies, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and help demonstrate how innovative imaging solutions can improve healthcare workflows.

 What You Will Do
 Design, Build, and Support Demonstration Environments
 • Install, configure, maintain, and optimize Enterprise Imaging demonstration environments supporting workflows and customer presentations.
 • Manage virtualized, on-premises, and cloud-based systems to ensure performance, reliability, and availability.
 • Configure and troubleshoot imaging applications, databases, operating systems, networking, and supporting infrastructure.
 • Prepare and validate demonstration systems for customer engagements, conferences, and strategic sales opportunities.
 • Proactively identify opportunities to improve system reliability, deployment efficiency, and demonstration capabilities.
 Enable Sales and Clinical Demonstrations
 • Partner with sales executives, solution architects, and clinical specialists to deliver high-quality technical demonstrations.
 • Support the configuration of customer-specific workflows and technical proof-of-concept environments.
 • Troubleshoot technical challenges during demonstration preparation and live customer engagements.
 • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to incorporate new product capabilities into demonstration platforms.
 Integrate Healthcare Imaging Technologies
 • Configure and troubleshoot DICOM and HL7 integrations between imaging systems and healthcare applications.
 • Support PACS, Vendor Neutral Archive (VNA), image viewers, and related enterprise imaging components.
 • Work with imaging datasets, DICOM services, clinical workflows, and interoperability interfaces.
 • Help demonstrate enterprise imaging workflows across multiple clinical and technical systems.
 Explore, Automate, and Innovate
 • Evaluate and implement technologies that improve demonstration capabilities, scalability, and performance.
 • Develop scripts and automation to streamline installation, configuration, maintenance, and deployment.
 • Gain hands-on experience with containerization, cloud infrastructure, and modern application architecture.
 • Collaborate with product management, development, and technical experts to support evolving solutions.

 Required Qualifications
 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 • Hands-on experience supporting, implementing, or administering enterprise software systems in healthcare IT, medical imaging, or a comparable technical environment.
 • Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration.
 • Experience troubleshooting complex software applications, infrastructure, networking, or system integrations.
 • Familiarity with PACS, medical imaging systems, or healthcare interoperability technologies such as DICOM or HL7.
 • Experience working with virtual machines, server environments, databases, or enterprise application infrastructure.
 • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate technical issues.
 • Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
 • A proactive mindset, willingness to learn new technologies, and ownership of technical outcomes.
 • Ability and willingness to travel up to 30% for customer demonstrations, conferences, and internal collaboration.

 Preferred Qualifications
 • Experience as a PACS Administrator, Enterprise Imaging Implementation Engineer, Healthcare IT Systems Engineer, or technical specialist supporting imaging solutions.
 • Experience with various vendors enterprise imaging products.
 • Experience with PACS, VNA, diagnostic viewers, subspecialty workflows, advanced visualization, and AI applications.
 • Knowledge of DICOM networking, image storage and retrieval, HL7 interfaces, and imaging interoperability.
 • Experience with virtualization platforms.
 • Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or similar relational databases.
 • Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or other container technologies.
 • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
 • Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, or similar tools.
 • Familiarity with networking, cybersecurity, identity management, and enterprise application deployment.
 • Experience supporting technical demonstrations, sales engineering, proof-of-concept environments, or customer-facing technical engagements.

 Why Join Us?
 Work with Innovative Healthcare Technology
 Contribute to the technical environments used to demonstrate next-generation imaging capabilities to healthcare organizations.

 Make a Visible Impact
 Your work will directly support customer experiences, sales opportunities, and the successful presentation of Siemens Healthineers technology.

 Collaborate Across Disciplines
 Work alongside experienced sales professionals, clinical specialists, solution architects, engineers, and product teams.

 Grow Your Career
 Whether your background is in PACS administration, enterprise imaging implementation, or technical systems engineering, this position offers an opportunity to broaden your skills and develop professionally within a global healthcare technology organization.

 Help shape the future of enterprise imaging with Siemens Healthineers.

 #LS-OS1
 
 Who we are : We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
 
 How we work: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
 
 To find out more about Siemens Healthineers businesses, please visit our company page here .
 
 The base pay range for this position is:
 
$117,770 - $161,931 
 Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate.
 
 If this is a commission eligible position the commission eligibility will be in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan. Commissions are based on individual performance and/or company performance. 
 
 The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan. life insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, paid parking/public transportation, paid time off, paid sick and safe time.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Siemens Healthineers is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability unrelated to ability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, order of protection status, protected veteran or military status, or an unfavorable discharge from military service, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law.
 
 EEO is the Law: Applicants and employees are protected under Federal law from discrimination. To learn more, click here .
 
 Reasonable Accommodations: Siemens Healthineers is committed to equal employment opportunity. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations.
 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please fill out the accommodations form here . If you’re unable to complete the form, you can reach out to our HR People Connect People Contact Center for support at peopleconnectvendorsnam.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Please note HR People Connect People Contact Center will not have visibility of your application or interview status. 
 
 California Privacy Notice: California residents have the right to receive additional notices about their personal information. To learn more, click here .
 
 Export Control: “A successful candidate must be able to work with controlled technology in accordance with US export control law.” “It is Siemens Healthineers’ policy to comply fully and completely with all United States export control laws and regulations, including those implemented by the Department of Commerce through the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), by the Department of State through the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), and by the Treasury Department through the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions regulations.”
 
 Data Privacy: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started. 
 
 Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.
 
 To all recruitment agencies: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
